sql: SELECT AVG(COALESCE(oxygen_count, 0)) as avg_oxygen_atoms FROM (SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) as oxygen_count FROM molecule m LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id AND a.element = 'o' WHERE m.molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id FROM bond b WHERE b.bond_type = '-') GROUP BY m.molecule_id)
